name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.45.1 adds optional authored-evidence observations on actual emitted recall blocks, a real-recall synthetic stress evaluator and paired lesson-cue observation scoring. Exact declared path, line and quote observations, missing requirements, blockers, scan coverage and output truncation remain separate. These are literal observations, not semantic truth, source freshness, permission or proof of authentic execution. Original synthetic fixtures exercise lexical distractors, distributed conditions and the 512 KiB UTF-8 boundary; the existing search algorithm and per-file skip remain unchanged. Lesson reports distinguish scripted demos from caller-reported host observations, missing or stale evidence, confounded and unpaired trials. No host, model or command is executed, and actual-host efficacy remains unmeasured. No restricted NoLiMa code/data is copied. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime, default recall bytes, hook bindings and configuration template stay unchanged. Publication does not upgrade active installations or company vaults. Native installed-resource verification, CI, certificate replay, ZIP rebuild and release attestations are separate gates. Hashes bind bytes, not identity, authority or truth. For older transitions where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. macOS test fixtures resolve only their owned temporary root; runtime linked-parent rejection is unchanged. The unpublished v0.45.0 candidate is superseded.
